obligations.statement: Every command and projection binds one exact workspace, Work Owner, artifact set, and accepted revision.
obligations.owner_route: Essays agent-runtime owner plus Work Owner
obligations.claim_limit: Identity presence does not prove that the selected workspace is intended or current.

obligations.statement: Only the Essays semantic transition authority can commit accepted state.
required_evidence: negative direct-write tests for every client and extension
obligations.owner_route: Essays agent-runtime owner plus Work Owner
obligations.claim_limit: The rule is not proof that an implementation has only one mutation authority.

obligations.statement: Every accepted-state mutation checks an explicit expected revision and returns a visible conflict on mismatch.
obligations.owner_route: Essays agent-runtime owner
obligations.claim_limit: Expected-revision checks do not prove all business conflicts are detected.

obligations.statement: A state-changing command is durably recorded before an accepted acknowledgement is returned.
required_evidence: crash-point fixtures around commit and acknowledgement
obligations.owner_route: Essays agent-runtime owner plus persistence owner
obligations.claim_limit: A receipt field is not durability evidence.

obligations.statement: A repeated request identity cannot apply a state-changing command twice and returns a compatible prior outcome.
obligations.owner_route: Essays agent-runtime owner
obligations.claim_limit: Idempotent command handling does not prove an external effect occurred exactly once.

obligations.statement: Desktop, CLI, local IPC, and authorized remote clients observe the same command, query, revision, event, and receipt semantics.
obligations.owner_route: Essays agent-runtime owner plus each client owner
obligations.claim_limit: Shared schemas do not prove behavioral parity.

obligations.statement: Locality, loopback, HTTP, IPC, connection identity, or transport success cannot enlarge capability or editorial authority.
obligations.owner_route: Essays security owner plus Essays agent-runtime owner
obligations.claim_limit: Transport authentication is not authorization.

obligations.statement: Every workspace snapshot distinguishes accepted state from proposals, evidence, conflicts, questions, and residue and carries a freshness cursor.
obligations.owner_route: Essays agent-runtime owner plus Work Owner
obligations.claim_limit: A qualified snapshot does not accept or reject included proposals.

obligations.statement: Every agent or component proposal binds exact producer, source revision, context, target, and operation provenance.
obligations.owner_route: Essays agent-runtime owner plus producer owner
obligations.claim_limit: Provenance does not prove proposal quality or correctness.

obligations.statement: Producing, storing, viewing, or validating a proposal cannot mutate accepted prose.
obligations.owner_route: Work Owner plus Essays agent-runtime owner
obligations.claim_limit: A non-mutating proposal is not accepted prose.

obligations.statement: Only the Work Owner can accept or reject a proposal, and every disposition is durable and revision-qualified.
obligations.owner_route: Work Owner
obligations.claim_limit: Recorded owner identity does not prove informed acceptance.

obligations.statement: Every operation classifies its context sufficient, insufficient, or indeterminate for its exact intended use.
obligations.owner_route: Essays agent-runtime owner plus Work Owner
obligations.claim_limit: A sufficiency result is purpose-bound and does not universalize context.

obligations.statement: Inferred context exposes provenance, confidence, conflicts, correction, and rejection before use.
obligations.owner_route: Work Owner plus Essays agent-runtime owner
obligations.claim_limit: Exposed controls do not make inferred context authoritative.

obligations.statement: Agent, WebAssembly, remote, browser, credential, file, and external-effect capabilities are denied unless explicitly granted for the exact operation.
required_evidence: unknown and ambient capability denial tests
obligations.owner_route: Essays security owner plus owner of each capability
obligations.claim_limit: A deny-by-default specification is not sandbox or enforcement proof.

obligations.statement: Every potentially external browser or remote action binds an explicit owner, actor, target, scope, expiry, revocation state, deadline, replay posture, and evidence expectation.
obligations.owner_route: Essays security owner plus Work Owner effect-policy owner plus exact effect owner
obligations.claim_limit: The obligation does not issue a grant or authorize an effect.

obligations.statement: Ambiguous outcome after effect dispatch becomes uncertain, prohibits implicit retry, and blocks dependent work until reconciliation.
obligations.owner_route: Essays security owner plus exact effect owner
obligations.claim_limit: Uncertainty classification does not determine the external truth.

obligations.statement: Browser evidence is bounded, redacted, provenance-bound, and remains separate from accepted prose and effect authority.
obligations.owner_route: Essays security owner plus Work Owner
obligations.claim_limit: Evidence custody does not prove an effect or accept content.

obligations.statement: Credentials and secrets never enter ordinary content, context, proposal, snapshot, log, or evidence fields and are referenced only through scoped protected handles.
obligations.owner_route: Essays security owner plus credential owner
obligations.claim_limit: Opaque handles do not prove secure custody or correct use.

obligations.statement: Every client, agent, component, browser session, command, stream, artifact, and effect is subject to explicit fail-closed resource and time ceilings.
obligations.owner_route: Essays agent-runtime owner plus Essays security owner
obligations.claim_limit: Selected ceilings are constraints, not performance or safety proof.

obligations.statement: Any realization handoff binds exact adopted definitions, Product Capability, dependent records, authored ontologies, DomainSpec source, generated ontology, residue, and owner decisions.
obligations.owner_route: Essays Project owner plus DomainSpec v2 owner plus Essays agent-runtime owner
obligations.claim_limit: D65 traceability is not implementation authorization or conformance.

claim_limit: These are candidate testable obligations derived from the adopted Product Capability and candidate business ontology. Their statuses are not aggregate conformance, security approval, realization selection, or implementation authority.
